title: extensions.embedder
description: Embedder configuration. Registers an embedder against the active graph so text_score() works inside Cypher. Requires trust.allow_embedder: true. The server reads library, model, factory and load; it hands the whole mapping to the Python builder, which ignores keys it does not know.

library.description: Embedding engine. 'fastembed-rs' is the Rust engine (cargo --features fastembed; requires model). 'fastembed' and 'sentence-transformers' are Python libraries hosted by the wheel. Any other value is rejected by the Python builder when the model is built.

model.description: Model name passed to the library; it must be in that library's catalog. Required unless factory is set.

factory.description: A 'module:attr' Python builder called with the model name and returning an EmbeddingModel (dimension + embed). Wins over library.

load.description: When the model is built. 'lazy' builds it on the first text_score() call; 'eager' builds it at boot.
